overview: This enum classifies a character into a broad story and combat category.

None.simple: The character has no broad group.
None.technical: None is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. The story relationship item casts it to uint8 and passes it to Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId, which selects no unique-words text id. A battle win with this group increments the win-without-jujutsu-sorcerers record. Command-list text uses the human Cursed Energy category unless another condition overrides it. The Character row constructor uses None as its default.

JujutsuSorcerers.simple: The character is a jujutsu sorcerer.
JujutsuSorcerers.technical: JujutsuSorcerers is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. The story relationship item casts it to uint8 and passes it to Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId, which selects GLS_UNIQUE_WORDS_0001. A battle win with this group increments the win-with-jujutsu-sorcerers record. Command-list text uses the human Cursed Energy category unless another condition overrides it.

CursedSpirits.simple: The character is a cursed spirit.
CursedSpirits.technical: CursedSpirits is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. The story relationship item casts it to uint8 and passes it to Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId, which selects GLS_UNIQUE_WORDS_0002. Command-list text uses the cursed Cursed Energy category. CN_240_ATTACKI_01_01 deals damage to a receiver only when that receiver has this group.

CursedWombDeathPaintings.technical: CursedWombDeathPaintings is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. Command-list text uses the cursed Cursed Energy category, and a battle win increments the win-without-jujutsu-sorcerers record.

CursedObjects.simple: The character is a cursed object.
CursedObjects.technical: CursedObjects is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. The story relationship item casts it to uint8 and passes it to Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId, which selects GLS_UNIQUE_WORDS_0005. Invalid.technical: Invalid is stored in CharacterDataTable.CharacterGroup. The story relationship item casts it to uint8 and passes it to Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId, which selects no unique-words text id. A battle win with this group falls into the win-without-jujutsu-sorcerers record. No exported Character row uses this value, so its intended authoring role is unresolved.

notes: The value is a categorical byte. Three battle states cast CharacterGroup to uint8 and pass it to AGameManager::OnBattleWon with the result grade.
Story_GetUniqueWordsTextId maps each real group to one GLS_UNIQUE_WORDS text id. None and Invalid fall through to an unset FName.
The command-list category groups CursedSpirits, CursedWombDeathPaintings, and CursedObjects together. All other groups use the human category after the CP_020 and physical-energy checks.
